title: DC-area forecast: Trending warmer and eventually brighter before a cooler weekend
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Partly to mostly cloudy as afternoon highs reach the mid-70s. Maybe a sprinkle or passing shower.

What’s next? Sunnier tomorrow through Friday with rising temperatures, even a taste of summer warmth Thursday and Friday. Cooler over the weekend with a chance of showers.

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: Considerable clouds, but peeks of sunshine and pleasantly warmer temperatures have the digit trending up. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Tuesday): Partly to mostly cloudy, with a passing shower or sprinkle possible. Highs reach the mid-70s with light winds from the northwest. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Just a few clouds around, with comfortably cool lows in the mid-50s to low 60s. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Partly to mostly sunny and warm, with highs reaching the upper 70s to low 80s. This should mark our first 80-degree day since September 20 — two Sundays ago! Light winds from the southwest. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tomorrow night: Partly cloudy and comfortable, with lows in the upper 50s to mid-60s. Light winds. Confidence: High

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Thursday, the first day of October, brings warm sunshine and highs in the low to mid-80s; some upper 80s are even possible. Humidity ticks up slightly, with dew points in the low 60s. Thursday night is mostly clear and mild, with lows in the 60s. Confidence: High

Friday will probably be the week’s warmest day, with partly to mostly sunny skies and highs in the mid- to upper 80s. Humidity is moderately high, with dew points in the mid- to upper 60s. A few spots could touch 90, but the record high of 98 from 2019 looks safe. A few more clouds arrive Friday night, with lows mostly in the 60s, although upper 50s are possible in our far western and northwestern areas. Confidence: Medium-High

This weekend brings temperatures back toward more reasonable October levels as rain chances return. Saturday is partly to mostly cloudy with a chance of showers, especially during the second half of the day, and highs in the 70s. Showers remain possible Saturday night. Sunday may bring periods of rain — especially during the first half of the day — with cloudy skies and cooler highs in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Low

Next week looks cooler than normal, with highs in the 60s to around 70.

DC weather history for September 29

A destructive 1896 hurricane remnant battered the region with damaging winds and flooding, while in 1924 another tropical system brought record rainfall and additional flooding.
